overviewParagraphs: Van Tri Golf Club is synonymous with exclusivity and high standards in the North of Vietnam. Conceptualized by Peter Rousseau, the layout is a brilliant execution of parkland golf, carved out of an expansive rural landscape just outside Hanoi's urban core.

Water plays a defining role in the Van Tri experience. It comes into play on the vast majority of holes, challenging golfers to make strategic decisions off the tee and demanding precise iron play on the approach. The fairways, carpeted in Paspalum, provide a lush, flawless surface that contrasts beautifully with the white sand bunkers.

Because it operates as a strictly private club, the course rarely sees the heavy traffic typical of resort courses, ensuring pristine conditions year-round. The opulent clubhouse matches the on-course standard, making Van Tri a mandatory stop for discerning travelers visiting the capital.

curatorBriefHtml: Van Tri Golf Club (opened 2007 in Dong Anh District, just 25 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport and 35 minutes north of central Hanoi) is Vietnam’s original strictly private members-only golf club. Crafted by Peter Rousseau across peaceful lakes and mature parkland (Par 72, stretching up to 7,601 yards from the championship tips), Van Tri is prized by diplomats, executives, and discerning locals for its serene pace of play and tournament-kept Paspalum turf.

Unlike high-volume resort courses, Van Tri caps daily rounds strictly — meaning zero backed-up tee boxes, unhurried caddie service, and refined clubhouse dining. Wide, tree-framed fairways invite confident driving before water hazards and subtle green slopes test iron accuracy on the approach.

Because Van Tri sits directly between Noi Bai International Airport and central Hanoi, AGS arranges curated weekday guest access for VIP groups seeking a prestigious, private-club start or finish to their Northern Vietnam itinerary alongside Sky Lake and Thanh Lanh Valley.

scorecard.verdict: Hanoi's most prestigious private membership club. Impeccably manicured fairways and lightning-fast greens weave through pine forests and tranquil water hazards. Uncompromising private luxury.

faqs.q: How can visiting golfers get onto the private Van Tri Golf Club?
faqs.a: Van Tri is a strictly private members-only club that does not accept walk-in bookings. Asia Golf Specialists arranges pre-approved guest tee times (primarily Tuesday–Friday) as part of bespoke Hanoi itineraries.

faqs.q: How close is Van Tri Golf Club to Hanoi and Noi Bai Airport?
faqs.a: Van Tri sits in Dong Anh just 20–25 minutes from Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) and 30–40 minutes north of central Hanoi — one of the shortest transfers in the capital.

faqs.q: What style of golf course is Van Tri?
faqs.a: Peter Rousseau designed a classic, serene lakeside parkland course (Par 72, up to 7,601 yards from the back tips, with comfortable forward tees) featuring sculpted water hazards, mature trees, and smooth Paspalum greens.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Van Tri Golf Club?
faqs.a: October through April delivers crisp, dry Northern Vietnam playing weather (18–26°C) and peak private-club conditioning.
